                                                                  FROM THE
                                                              PRINCIPAL’S DESK



         I take immense pride in congratulating every diligent student who has exhibited unwavering
determination to excel in their respective fields of study and successfully cleared their last
examinations. Your hard work and perseverance have undoubtedly paid off, and you are now one step
closer to achieving your academic goals.
         As we gear up for the academic session 2025-2026, I would like to extend a warm and cordial
welcome to all the aspiring students who wish to embark on their journey of higher education with
Thong Nokbe College. Our institution has been a beacon of excellence, providing quality education
and nurturing young minds to become competent professionals in their chosen fields. We are
committed to providing our students with a conducive environment that fosters holistic development,
enabling them to achieve their full potential.
         The concerted efforts of a multitude of professionals, including educationists, academicians,
administrators, and others alike, have sparked a new sense of hope and optimism. Their collaborative
efforts have been tirelessly focused on achieving the goal of creating the best institution possible, one
that excels in all aspects of its operations within the area.
         In the modern era, the approach towards formal education has undergone a significant
transformation. Keeping up with the ever-evolving NEP 2020, educational institutions have adopted
new and innovative methods of teaching to fulfil the educational needs of students. The Thong Nokbe
College is no exception and has taken proactive measures to serve the educational requirements of its
students. The college has introduced various modes of classes, such as remedial and tutor classes, to
help students who may require additional attention and support. Additionally, the college has made
use of modern teaching aids, such as audio-visual aids, to enhance the learning process and make it
more effective.
         At our institution, our primary focus is to impart knowledge to our students and instil in them
the virtues of adaptability, livelihood skills, and responsible citizenship. We believe that by doing so,
we can help raise a generation of socially conscious citizens who will grow up to be accountable and
empathetic individuals.
         We understand that education is not just about academics, and that's why our teachers are
always ready to help our students with their extracurricular activities as well. We strive to create a
sense of social responsibility, love, compassion, and kindness in our students to help them become
better human beings.
         We firmly believe that education should have a purpose, and we are committed to making
education meaningful for society. By instilling these values in our students, we hope to create a better
future for all. I wish all very rewarding and enlightening educational days at Thong Nokbe College.

                                  PROFILE

        THONG NOKBE COLLEGE
        Thong Nokbe College is one of the oldest institutions of higher education in
Karbi Anglong district.
        Established in 1984, this college is the second educational institution of its kind
in Karbi Anglong. Nestled in a picturesque locale, it is situated next to the Mohamaya
Hills of Dokmoka. The college primarily caters to the educational needs of tribal
students hailing from semi-urban and rural regions of Dokmoka and its nearby areas. It
imparts education in Arts and Science at both Higher Secondary and Degree levels.
The language of instruction at the Higher Secondary level is both English and
Assamese, while at the Degree level, it is English.
        For a long time, there was a pressing need for a college in the wider Dokmoka-
Langhin area. Common people in the region found it exceedingly difficult to send their
children to Diphu or other towns for higher education. In response, a group of forward-
thinking individuals emerged, including Lt. LongkamTeron, Lt. Indra Rongphar, Lt.
Dorsing Terang, Lt. Nilo Mohan Brahma, Lt. Sadhon Senapoti, Lt. Bidyadhar Bora,
Shri Bidya Sing Engleng, Shri Dhaniram Tisso, and many others. Together, they took
the initiative to establish a college in Dokmoka in 1984, on a venture basis. The college
was formally inaugurated on September 7th, 1984, by Lt. Mukut Sharma, who was then
the Education Minister of the Government of Assam. The college was named after
Thong Nokbe, a legendary Karbi commander who fought and sacrificed his life for the
emancipation of his tribe from feudal oppression.
        The college started with only 55 students and 5 teachers, but it has grown over
the years and now has more than 1800 students. It is permanently affiliated with Assam
University, Silchar, which was established under an Act of Parliament. Initially, the
college was funded by the Governing Body and periodic grants from the Karbi Anglong
Autonomous Council (KAAC). In 2008, the KAAC took over the college under the
deficit Grant-in-Aid system, and later it was provincialized under the Assam Venture
Educational Institutions (Provincialisation of Services) Act, 2011. In 2015, the college
was recognized by the UGC under 2-F and 12-B provisions. The college is managed by
a registered society under the Societies Registration Act, which has a duly constituted
Governing Body (GB) that oversees the administrative affairs of the college.
        The primary objective of the college is to provide the most advanced form of
higher education to students, while also instilling in them the virtues of adaptability,
skill acquisition, and good citizenship. To achieve this objective, the college strives to
prepare students academically for Higher Secondary and Degree Examinations both in
the Arts and Science Streams with the ultimate goal of producing efficient human
resources within the district. These resources will be instrumental in promoting the
betterment of the district, and will serve as conscientious citizens who contribute
positively to society.

                                        MOTTO
       The College aims at contributing to establishing the principles of social justice and
equality of status and opportunity as enshrined in the Indian constitution. The Motto of the
college is ‘Educate: Enlighten: Empower’. The college is committed to imparting education
laying stress on the all-round development of the students. This is because the college firmly
endorses the idea that when people become educated they become enlightened and when people
are enlightened they become empowered to make the positive difference they wish to see in the
world and themselves.




                                        EMBLEM
       The emblem of the college is the traditional Karbi shield and swords called Chong-Nok
in Karbi language which is illuminated by a lighted earthen lamp at the bottom. The shield
symbolizes the armour of protection against all sorts of evils in society while the swords
symbolize the unrelenting fight against ignorance and deprivation. The lighted lamp symbolizes
the elimination of the evils of darkness through the dissemination of education and knowledge.
The round shape of the shield displays the name of the college while the motto of the college is
displayed on the swords accompanying the shiel.

  *Examination:
  The Degree Examination includes the following:
  Internal Assessment (IA): 30 marks
   IA is known as Continuous and Comprehensive Assessment (CCA) which includes:

  1. Unit Test: 20 marks
  There will be two Unit Tests per semester for theory papers excluding the Skill Enhancement Course.
  The highest mark scored by a student out of two Unit Tests shall be awarded to the student.
   There will be NO Unit Test for practical paper—however, for each practical paper; marks for
attendance will be awarded in practical examination.

  2. Attendance: 10 marks
   A student with less than 75% attendance on an average of all the papers of the concerned semester
shall NOT be allowed to appear in that semester’s examination. However, such a student may appear
in the subsequent examination in all the papers.
   There will be provisions for condonation of attendance for the students to represent the college in
different co-curricular activities.
  There shall be two components of IA: (1) Unit Test (20 marks) & (2) Class Attendance (10 marks).
  • End-Semester Exam: 70 marks

Krishna Kanta Handiqui State Open University (KKHSOU)is the only state Open University
in the whole of North East India and is the fourteenth of its kind along with IGNOU in all over
India. Established under the provision of the KKHSOU Act 2005 enacted by the Govt. of Assam
& published in the Assam Gazette (extraordinary) dt 29/9/05, the KKHSOU has been
recognized by the Distance Education Council, New Delhi vide letter no.
DEC/Misc/07/5957dated03/10/07. The University Grants Commission vide its letter No. F.9-
13/2008(CPP-I) dated 18th March 2009 also has empowered the University to award degrees
under Section 22 of the UGC Act, 1956. The university is recognized by the University Grants
Commission and Distance Education Council, Govt. of India. The headquarters of the
University is located at Khanapara, Guwahati.

The main aim of the university is to develop and provide easily accessible modes of quality
higher education and training with the use of the latest educational inputs and technology. The
very purpose of the University is to promote education to reach the unreached through the Open
and Distance Learning System and the motto of the University is Education Beyond Barriers’ of
age, academic background and geographical boundaries. To provide individualised support to
its learners the KKHSOU has a large number of designated Study Centres spread all over
Assam.

Thong Nokbe College is privileged to have such a Study Centre of KKHSOU which became
operational in the 2015 academic session. Ever since its launching at Thong Nokbe College,
the KKHSOU- Thong Nokbe College Study Centre (Centre Code:1608)has received a huge
response from the local students as a large number of students have started availing the
educational facilities provided by the Study Centre by enrolling themselves here.
